# mxroute_email_accounts (Data Source)

List mailboxes and volatile usage in an owned domain. No passwords are returned. Collection completeness remains live-unverified.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mxroute_email_accounts" "mailboxes" {
  domain = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Owned canonical domain.

### Read-Only

- `accounts` (Attributes Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--accounts))

<a id="nestedatt--accounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `accounts`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) Mailbox email address.
- `limit` (Number) Daily send limit.
- `quota` (Number) Storage quota in MB; zero means unlimited.
- `sent` (Number) Volatile daily sent count.
- `suspended` (Boolean) Server-reported suspension status.
- `usage` (Number) Volatile storage usage in MB.
- `username` (String) Server canonical mailbox local part.
